author: Jeff Bowman
text: Amazing service. We use Josh and his team for all our septic needs. Great service and very willing to explain all the detail. 1-10 they are a 12! We appreciate everything your company does for us! Call little rooster if you want the best for reasonable prices!

author: A Roussel
text: Josh came highly recommended and now I know why. Honest, knowledgeable, and thorough. He came out to inspect our aerobic septic system and took the time to answer all of my questions without rushing. He confirmed the tank did not need unnecessary pumping, which I appreciated. While checking the system, he noticed the pump alarm wasn’t behaving properly, he investigated further, and found that the air line to the tank was broken and the system was not properly aerating. I’m very grateful he caught the issue. Fair pricing, professional service, and Josh clearly knows these systems well. Highly recommend.

author: Lane Bennett
text: Josh is the best, hands down.  Josh is a phenomenal business person that is prompt, experienced, always communicative and a master at septic work of all kinds. Caring about customers as people first, his company is extremely reasonable in their prices and reassure you there are still professionals that are conscientious.

author: Laurie Tullier
text: Little Rooster was super fast and very reliable! They took care of my system like it was their own. I will call them back and recommend them to everyone for sure!!!

author: Alyson Boe
text: I have nothing but great things to say about Josh and his company. I had an emergency septic tank and drain pipe issue. Little Rooster was able to come out and make the repairs with a quick turnaround. Would recommend to anyone in need of any plumbing/sewage needs!
